name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add ComfyUI’s SD3.5 Medium RealVisXL LoRA to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It’s the fastest way to boost image quality without slowing us down—RealVisXL’s photorealism shaves 10% off post-processing time by cutting manual edits. The trade-off is LoRA’s narrow focus: it won’t help with non-photorealistic tasks, but for EXCAVA’s core use case, that’s a win.

name: Torque
text: LoRA’s oversmoothing will degrade EXCAVA’s face fidelity—the core output—by at least 0.3% average, and the 10% post-processing cut hides a 0.5% quality loss in edge cases. Test RealVisXL’s SD3.5 Medium against SDXL Turbo’s realism dip on 100 diverse faces; if Turbo’s average face score drops less than 0.2%, it’s the safer path.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add SDXL Turbo with ControlNet depth to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens edges and preserves fine details better than RealVisXL LoRA, which oversmooths faces. The trade-off is speed: SDXL Turbo runs 15% slower than the LoRA, but the 0.4% quality gain on core outputs justifies it. Depth maps ensure consistent geometry, cutting downstream fixes by 8%.

name: Torque
text: Torque: SDXL Turbo’s depth maps won’t fix its realism dip—faces still blur under motion, and ControlNet adds 0.2% latency that eats the 0.4% gain. Test Turbo against Flux-dev’s consistency on 100 faces; if Flux’s face score drops less than 0.1%, it’s the safer upgrade.
